-- Summary: Composite: devices missing any required metadata (manufacturer/model/status/eqclass/commission date, plus category rule for AVC/AVD) — total (vanilla)
-- Returns: one row, one column: value (bigint)

WITH
active_devices AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM eam_devices d
  WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(d.assetstatus_display::varchar), ''), '__MISSING__') NOT IN ('Withdrawn', 'Hors service définitif')
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*)::bigint AS value
FROM active_devices d
WHERE
  (d.manufacturer IS NULL OR trim(d.manufacturer) = '') OR
  (d.model IS NULL OR trim(d.model) = '') OR
  (d.assetstatus_display IS NULL OR trim(d.assetstatus_display) = '') OR
  (d.eqclass IS NULL OR trim(d.eqclass) = '') OR
  (d.commissiondate IS NULL) OR
  ((d.category IS NULL OR trim(d.category) = '' OR lower(trim(d.category)) = 'none') AND d.eqclass IN ('AVC','AVD'));

-- Summary: Composite: devices missing any required metadata — total (sum of under-room + parentless + positionless)
-- Returns: one row, one column: value (bigint)
-- Value is the sum of:
--   - devices_with_room (has room)
--   - devices_no_parent (parentless / no-room resolution)
--   - no_position_devices (positionless)

WITH RECURSIVE
active_devices AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM eam_devices d
  WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(d.assetstatus_display::varchar), ''), '__MISSING__') NOT IN ('Withdrawn', 'Hors service définitif')
),
device_positions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.position::varchar AS position
  FROM active_devices d
  WHERE d.position IS NOT NULL
),
pos_joinable AS (
  -- Only positions that exist in eam_positions (so recursion can start)
  SELECT dp.position
  FROM device_positions dp
  JOIN eam_positions p
    ON p.equipmentno::varchar = dp.position
),
climb AS (
  SELECT
    pj.position                              AS start_pos,
    p.equipmentno::varchar                   AS cur_pos,
    p.parentasset::varchar                   AS parent_pos,
    0                                        AS depth,
    ARRAY[p.equipmentno::varchar]::varchar[] AS visited
  FROM pos_joinable pj
  JOIN eam_positions p
    ON p.equipmentno::varchar = pj.position

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    c.start_pos,
    p.equipmentno::varchar,
    p.parentasset::varchar,
    c.depth + 1,
    (c.visited || p.equipmentno::varchar)::varchar[]
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions p
    ON p.equipmentno::varchar = c.parent_pos
  WHERE c.parent_pos IS NOT NULL
    AND c.depth < 100
    AND NOT p.equipmentno::varchar = ANY (c.visited)
),
pos_to_room AS (
  -- Positions that DO resolve to an AVR room (root node)
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos AS room_no,
    c.depth
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions rp
    ON rp.equipmentno::varchar = c.cur_pos
  WHERE rp.eqclass = 'AVR'
    AND rp.category IN ('AV-VCR','AV-VIS','AV-MRO')
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
root_per_pos AS (
  -- Deepest reachable node per start_pos (even if it never hits AVR)
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos    AS root_pos,
    c.parent_pos AS root_parent
  FROM climb c
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
no_parent_positions AS (
  -- "No Parent" (per dashboard semantics):
  -- joinable position that did not resolve to an AVR room, and either:
  --   - chain ends (root_parent IS NULL & root_pos is not AVR), OR
  --   - parent reference is broken (root_parent missing)
  SELECT r.start_pos
  FROM root_per_pos r
  JOIN eam_positions rp
    ON rp.equipmentno::varchar = r.root_pos
  LEFT JOIN pos_to_room pr
    ON pr.start_pos = r.start_pos
  WHERE pr.start_pos IS NULL
    AND (
      (r.root_parent IS NULL AND rp.eqclass <> 'AVR')
      OR (r.root_parent IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM eam_positions p2
            WHERE p2.equipmentno::varchar = r.root_parent
          ))
    )
),
no_position_devices AS (
  -- "No Position" = device.position is NULL/blank OR device.position does not exist in eam_positions
  SELECT d.*
  FROM active_devices d
  LEFT JOIN eam_positions p
    ON p.equipmentno::varchar = d.position::varchar
  WHERE d.position IS NULL
     OR trim(d.position::varchar) = ''
     OR p.equipmentno IS NULL
),
devices_with_room AS (
  -- Devices whose position chain resolves to a room (AVR)
  SELECT d.*
  FROM active_devices d
  JOIN pos_to_room pr
    ON pr.start_pos = d.position::varchar
),
devices_no_parent AS (
  -- Devices whose position chain does NOT resolve to a room (per no_parent_positions)
  SELECT d.*
  FROM active_devices d
  JOIN no_parent_positions np
    ON np.start_pos = d.position::varchar
)

SELECT (
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM devices_with_room d WHERE (d.manufacturer IS NULL OR trim(d.manufacturer) = '') OR
  (d.model IS NULL OR trim(d.model) = '') OR
  (d.assetstatus_display IS NULL OR trim(d.assetstatus_display) = '') OR
  (d.eqclass IS NULL OR trim(d.eqclass) = '') OR
  (d.commissiondate IS NULL) OR
  ((d.category IS NULL OR trim(d.category) = '' OR lower(trim(d.category)) = 'none') AND d.eqclass IN ('AVC','AVD')))
  +
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM devices_no_parent d WHERE (d.manufacturer IS NULL OR trim(d.manufacturer) = '') OR
  (d.model IS NULL OR trim(d.model) = '') OR
  (d.assetstatus_display IS NULL OR trim(d.assetstatus_display) = '') OR
  (d.eqclass IS NULL OR trim(d.eqclass) = '') OR
  (d.commissiondate IS NULL) OR
  ((d.category IS NULL OR trim(d.category) = '' OR lower(trim(d.category)) = 'none') AND d.eqclass IN ('AVC','AVD')))

  (d.commissiondate IS NULL) OR
  ((d.category IS NULL OR trim(d.category) = '' OR lower(trim(d.category)) = 'none') AND d.eqclass IN ('AVC','AVD')))
)::bigint AS value;

annotations.description:
- Missing Metadata
  This alert tracks the number of devices in EAM Assets that are missing required metadata fields used for inventory consistency and dashboard filtering.
  - A device is counted if any of the following fields are NULL/empty: manufacturer, model, commissioned date, status, eqclass.
  - In addition, category is required only when eqclass is in scope (AVC or AVD); a device is counted for missing category only if eqclass is AVC or AVD and category is NULL/empty.
  Missing metadata reduces data quality, breaks filtering/grouping in dashboards, and makes operational reporting unreliable.
  Action is required to complete the missing fields in EAM so the device can be correctly classified, tracked, and monitored.

)

  COUNT(*)::bigint AS value
FROM active_devices d
LEFT JOIN eam_positions p
  ON p.equipmentno::varchar = d.position::varchar
WHERE
  d.position IS NULL
  OR trim(d.position::varchar) = ''
  OR p.equipmentno IS NULL;

annotations.description:
- Positionless devices
  This alert tracks the number of devices present in EAM Assets that do not have a valid Position field in their EAM register.
  - A device is counted if its position field is empty or NULL.
  These devices cannot be mapped to rooms and indicate incomplete or inconsistent data in EAM.
  Action is required to assign or fix the device position so it can be correctly linked in inventory and dashboards.

annotations.description:
- Devices Missing Category (AVC/AVD)
  This alert tracks the number of devices in EAM Assets where category is missing, but only for devices of class AVC or AVD.
  - A device is counted if eqclass is AVC/AVD and category is NULL/empty or set to 'None'.
  Missing categories for AVC/AVD devices breaks consistent classification and can cause incomplete filtering and reporting in dashboards.
  Action is required to set the correct category in EAM for these devices.
